🎤 Lyrics: Waylon Wyatt - Phoning Heaven

[Verse 1]

But you're long from forgotten
Been forever since we've seen your face

It's just easier to live through
This life thinkin' you're one call away
Only one call away

[Verse 2]
And ever since the day you parted
You left us all so brokenhearted
Memories of you runnin' through our minds
Well, I found your old contact
In a phone book a good while back
And I just wanna call it sometimes
In hopes you'll be on the other line

[Chorus]
If I could make a call up to Heavеn
I'd be phoning you 24/7
Not a single day'd pass without you hearing a ring
Had to put mе on speaker, hear them angels sing

[Verse 3]
Each time I cry over you leaving
I dial your phone hoping you're receiving
A ring from me to you up above
And though the phone goes straight to voicemail
Can't help from thinkin' it won't fail
That maybe one day you'll pick up
And you'd share a few words from above

[Chorus]
If I could make a call up to Heaven
I'd be phoning you 24/7
Not a single day'd pass without you hearing a ring
You could tell me all about the good Lord
While I'm here wishin' I could do more
Than to talk to you only in my dreams
At least there, Heaven ain't as far as it seems

[Outro]
If I could make a call up to Heaven
I'd be phoning you 24/7
Not a single day'd pass without you hearing a ring
Had to put me on speaker, hear them angels sing
